definition.accounting_rule: Allocate each independently evidenced source cost once across registered cost centres; disclose shared incidents and dependence. Recognition: Recognize eligible expense by incurred UTC date in the registered subject-year, not incident onset, payment or recording date. Annual frequency counts incidents with eligible recovery activity in that year, including carry-in; severity is only their eligible within-year incremental direct expense, excluding carry-out. Excluded: Routine controls and already-budgeted operating cost; Missed sales, fines, premiums, customer/patient losses; Double-counted shared incident costs, forecast-generated outcomes and synthetic tests Collection-policy-sha256=5d77ac2f15f4179f006cdb61deb2f75425325b6e1fb8169ce6bbe574c3d9e5c1
definition.completeness_rule: Complete cost-centre incident ledger plus attributable invoices/worklogs and an independent final completeness attestation; an empty log is not zero.
definition.finality_rule: Year-end independent reconciliation and signed final/complete record; unresolved or disputed amounts are ineligible. Closing within 31 days is a process target.
loss_categories: Incremental incident-response and restoration labour at an agreed charge-out rule, supported by worklogs
Actual incremental restoration/vendor invoices allocated once to a registered cost centre

unit.basis: nominal direct security-incident recovery expense per registered subject-year
